en.headline: M+ stays open until 10pm today for Golden Week
en.dek: West Kowloon says M+ and the Palace Museum will keep extended hours through 7 October, and asks visitors to book ahead.
body: M+ will stay open until 10pm on Friday, and the Hong Kong Palace Museum until 8pm, as West Kowloon keeps both museums open through the mainland National Day holiday.

The West Kowloon Cultural District Authority said the arrangement runs from 1 to 7 October. On Friday the Palace Museum is open from 10am to 8pm, and M+ from 10am to 10pm. On Saturday both stay open until 8pm. From Sunday the Palace Museum remains open until 8pm through Monday, while M+ closes at 6pm. The Authority said visitors should pre-book tickets and use public transport where they can, including the MTR, buses and the WestK ferry between Central and West Kowloon.

The Palace Museum's special exhibition of jewellery from the Metropolitan Museum of Art, The Body Transformed, runs until 19 October. The museum lists a special-exhibition ticket covering that show and the thematic galleries at HK$150 for adults and HK$75 for concessions, and says same-day tickets are sold at the ticket office while stocks last.

zh.headline: 黃金周西九兩館延長開放 M+今晚十時閉館
zh.dek: 西九文化區表示，M+及故宮文化博物館在國慶黃金周維持延長開放，並建議訪客預先購票。
body: 西九文化區在內地國慶黃金周期間維持M+及香港故宮文化博物館開放。周五M+開放至晚上十時，故宮文化博物館開放至晚上八時。
西九文化區管理局表示，安排涵蓋十月一日至七日。周五故宮文化博物館由上午十時開放至晚上八時，M+由上午十時開放至晚上十時。周六兩館均開放至晚上八時。周日起至周一，故宮文化博物館仍開放至晚上八時，M+則於下午六時關門。管理局建議訪客預先購票，並盡量乘公共交通前往，包括港鐵、巴士，以及來往中環與西九的西九渡輪。
故宮文化博物館與紐約大都會藝術博物館合辦的特別展覽「全球瑰寶：身體的蛻變」展期至十月十九日。館方列出的特別展覽門票涵蓋該展及專題展覽，成人150元，優惠票75元，並表示即日門票在票務處有餘票時發售。
